item.logisticspipes.module_item_sink.des: Takes the listed items. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_extractor.des: Pushes items out of the inventory to any pipe that takes them.
item.logisticspipes.module_provider.desc: Makes the contents of the inventory available to requests.
item.logisticspipes.module_terminus.desc: Takes the listed items when no ItemSink has room. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_passive_suppl: Takes passing items until the inventory holds the listed amounts, before any ItemSink gets them. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_polymorphic_i: Takes more of whatever the inventory already holds.
item.logisticspipes.module_advanced_extr: An extractor that only touches the listed items, or all but those. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_mod_item_sink: Takes every item of the listed mods. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_tag_item_sink: Takes every item with one of the listed tags. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_creative_tab_: Takes every item of the listed creative tabs. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_enchantment_s: Takes enchanted versions of the listed items. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_crafter.descr: Crafts like a crafting pipe. Use it in your hand to set it up.
item.logisticspipes.module_active_suppli: Orders the listed items to keep the inventory stocked, like a supplier pipe. Use it in your hand to set it up.
logisticspipes.gui.names.hint: Put an item in the slot to see what it offers
item.logisticspipes.module_quick_sort.de: Moves whole stacks to pipes that list the item, never to default routes.
item.logisticspipes.remote_orderer.descr: Sneak and use on a Request Pipe to link it, then use it anywhere to order. A key can be set in the controls to open it from the inventory.
logisticspipes.remote_orderer.not_linked: Not linked to a Request Pipe yet
logisticspipes.remote_orderer.other_dime: The linked Request Pipe is in another dimension
logisticspipes.remote_orderer.pipe_missi: The linked Request Pipe is gone or too far away to be loaded
item.logisticspipes.settings_copier.desc: Sneak and use on a routed pipe to copy its settings, use on another pipe of the same kind to paste them. On a chassis the settings go onto modules of the same kind in the same slot.
logisticspipes.settings_copier.empty: Nothing copied yet, sneak and use on a pipe first
item.logisticspipes.upgrade_sneaky.descr: The pipe uses another face of its inventory. Use in your hand to turn it, use on a pipe to install.
item.logisticspipes.upgrade_speed.descri: Items leaving the pipe travel a quarter faster per upgrade, up to four. Use on a pipe to install.
item.logisticspipes.upgrade_module_upgra: Gives every module of a chassis two upgrade slots of its own.
item.logisticspipes.upgrade_action_speed: An extractor module works twice as often per upgrade. Goes into the upgrade slots of the module.
item.logisticspipes.upgrade_item_extract: An extractor module moves 16 more items at a time per upgrade, up to eight. Goes into the upgrade slots of the module.
item.logisticspipes.upgrade_item_stack_e: An extractor module moves a stack more and one more kind of item at a time per upgrade, up to eight. Goes into the upgrade slots of the module.
item.logisticspipes.pipe_controller.desc: Use on a routed pipe to get at its upgrades.
logisticspipes.request.no_power: Request failed, the network does not have enough power
block.logisticspipes.transport_pipe.desc: Plain pipe that connects routed pipes. Items pass through, forks are fine.
block.logisticspipes.basic_logistics_pip: Routed pipe that takes the listed items into its inventory. Switch the default route on to make it take whatever nobody else wants.
block.logisticspipes.provider_pipe.descr: Makes the contents of its inventory available to requests.
block.logisticspipes.request_pipe.descri: Order items from the network here. They arrive in the inventory next to the pipe, or drop out if there is none.
block.logisticspipes.supplier_pipe.descr: Keeps its inventory stocked with the listed amounts. It reorders when an item is down to half.
block.logisticspipes.crafting_pipe.descr: Crafts its recipe on request with the machine or Logistics Crafting Table next to it. Ingredients are delivered to that inventory. With a satellite number set, the bottom row of the recipe goes to the Satellite Pipe with the same number instead.
block.logisticspipes.satellite_pipe.desc: A second drop off point for a Crafting Pipe with the same satellite number: the bottom row of its recipe is delivered here.
block.logisticspipes.logistics_crafting_: Crafts the recipe in its grid from stored ingredients whenever a pipe takes out the result. Put a Crafting Pipe next to it and press Import in the pipe.
block.logisticspipes.power_junction.desc: Stores energy for the routed pipes next to it and their whole network. Nothing moves without it: sorting costs a little per stack, filling requests, extracting and crafting cost per item.
block.logisticspipes.chassis_pipe_mk1.de: Routed pipe that does what the modules plugged into it do. Holds 1 module.
block.logisticspipes.chassis_pipe_mk2.de: Routed pipe that does what the modules plugged into it do. Holds 2 modules.
block.logisticspipes.chassis_pipe_mk3.de: Routed pipe that does what the modules plugged into it do. Holds 3 modules.
block.logisticspipes.chassis_pipe_mk4.de: Routed pipe that does what the modules plugged into it do. Holds 4 modules.
block.logisticspipes.chassis_pipe_mk5.de: Routed pipe that does what the modules plugged into it do. Holds 8 modules.
logisticspipes.jei.recipe_does_not_fit: A crafting pipe takes up to nine different items
logisticspipes.status.alone: Not connected to other logistics pipes
